title: LaPrizza Kitchen Configuration Layout
description: JSON Schema for the KitchenConfiguration.json_content column (ADR-011). Validated at the application boundary by KitchenConfigValidationService (a Pure Fabrication per GRASP Information Expert) before persisting. Backend does not interpret semantic coordinates; it guarantees structural and referential integrity only. The Angular + Three.js SPA is the sole consumer of the payload for rendering (ADR-014).

schemaVersion.description: Forward-compatible schema version (major.minor). Enables the Three.js viewer to select a parser. Bump minor for additive changes; bump major for breaking changes.

equipment.description: Ordered collection of physical equipment placed in the 3D scene. Each entry maps 1:1 to a GLB asset (ADR-014). IDs must be unique within the array; the backend validator enforces this at the application layer because JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness by property.

lights.description: Scene lighting scheme. At least one ambient (or hemisphere) light is strongly recommended to prevent fully-black zones (SGRAI best practice §53.3).

animationTriggers.description: Sprint 3 readiness — declarative animation triggers consumed by the Three.js AnimationMixer. Empty in Sprint 2.

metadata.description: Optional human-readable context. Not consumed by the renderer; used by the Manager UI and audit trail.

name.description: Human label. May differ from the KitchenConfiguration.name (business key) if the layout is duplicated.

dimensions.description: Axis-aligned bounding box of the kitchen floor in metres. Three.js right-handed convention: +X right, +Y up, +Z toward observer.

x.description: Width in metres. Upper bound protects against accidental huge values that break shadow-map scaling.

vec3.description: Three-component vector. Order is [x, y, z]. Rotation components are in radians (Three.js Euler convention).

colorHex.description: 6-digit hexadecimal RGB colour. Alpha is expressed via the 'intensity' field on lights, never in the colour itself.

equipmentCategory.description: Semantic category used by the Three.js scene for grouping, shadow bias tweaks, and animation targeting. Defaults to 'other' when omitted.

id.description: Stable identifier. Kebab-case, lowercase. Referenced by animationTriggers.targetEquipmentId. Uniqueness across the equipment array is enforced by KitchenConfigValidationService.

label.description: Display label shown in the Manager UI and in tooltips (Sprint 3).

modelUrl.description: Relative URL of the GLB asset. Enforces ADR-014: exclusively GLTF 2.0 binary format. In the current deployment the SPA serves these from frontend/public/assets/3d/models/ via Nginx.

position.description: Translation in metres, relative to the kitchen floor origin.

rotation.description: Euler rotation in radians, XYZ order (Three.js default).

scale.description: Per-axis scale. All components must be strictly positive. Values above 100 are rejected to catch unit-mismatch mistakes (cm vs m) at the boundary.

target.description: Optional look-at target. Defaults to origin.

castShadow.description: Enables shadow casting. Only one directional light should cast shadows to keep the N+1 re-render budget under control (§54.1).

distance.description: Maximum reach in metres; 0 means infinite.

angle.description: Outer cone angle in radians (max π/2). Use THREE.MathUtils.degToRad() at authoring time.

penumbra.description: Fraction of the outer cone covered by the inner (softer) cone.

targetEquipmentId.description: Must reference an equipment[].id. Referential integrity is validated by KitchenConfigValidationService at the application layer.

delay.description: Delay in seconds before the trigger fires.
